intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Amity Noida vs IMS Noida is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the BBA / BBM / BBS classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Amity Noida vs IMS Noida for BBA / BBM / BBS: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity Noida if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹8 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹3.88 lakh, in a private BBA / BBM / BBS setting at Noida.
Choose IMS Noida if you want a 2020 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹1.45 lakh, in a private BBA / BBM / BBS setting at Noida.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹3.88 lakh as a tuition figure for Dual BBA + MBA at Amity Noida. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹1.45 lakh as a programme total for Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) at IMS Noida.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Amity Noida's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹8 LPA and a highest package of ₹62 LPA on BBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

IMS Noida's latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹10 LPA on Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2023 and 2020, so the packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Amity Noida on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for IMS Noida on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Uttar Pradesh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Amity Noida's recorded ₹3.88 lakh or IMS Noida's ₹1.45 lakh fits your budget for this BBA / BBM / BBS.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether IMS Noida's recorded ₹1.45 lakh or Amity Noida's ₹3.88 lakh fits your budget for this BBA / BBM / BBS.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Amity Noida or IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Amity Noida and IMS Noida differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of BBA / BBM / BBS classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Amity Noida vs IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹3.88 lakh for Amity Noida on Dual BBA + MBA; our records list ₹1.45 lakh for IMS Noida on Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA). Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Amity Noida and IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: Amity Noida's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹8 LPA and a highest package of ₹62 LPA on BBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Amity Noida and IMS Noida accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for Amity Noida, and no listed exam on this page for IMS Noida. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Amity Noida and IMS Noida in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
